channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Khilaafka Bayern Munich iyo Kanada ee ku saabsan dhaawaca Alphonso Davies oo sii xoogeystay
item.description: Madaxa fulinta ee Bayern Munich Jan-Christian Dreesen ayaa si adag uga jawaabay eedeymaha tababaraha xulka Kanada Jesse Marsch, kaddib dhaawac cusub oo soo gaaray difaaca Alphonso Davies xilli uu la joogay xulka qaranka.

item.title: Lautaro Martínez oo la filayo inuu Inter ugu bilaabo kulanka Genoa markii ugu horreysay muddo lix toddobaad ah
item.description: Kabtanka Inter Lautaro Martínez ayaa la filayaa inuu Sabtida ka bilaabo safka hore kulanka Serie A ee Genoa ee San Siro, markii ugu horreysay tan iyo dhaawac uu soo gaaray bartamihii October.

item.title: Liverpool oo dabiga Merseyside u aadaysa iyadoo aan haysan Gakpo iyo Gravenberch
item.description: Liverpool ayaa kulanka dabiga Merseyside ee Premier League ee ay booqanayso Everton ku seegaysa weeraryahanka Cody Gakpo, halka khadka dhexe Ryan Gravenberch la filayo inuusan sidoo kale ciyaarin, labadaba dhaawacyo awgood.

item.title: Xeer-ilaaliye Argentina ah oo codsaday baaritaan lacag uu ururka AFA u wareejiyay madaxweynihiisa Claudio Tapia
item.description: Xeer-ilaaliyaha Argentina Gerardo Pollicita ayaa codsaday in la baaro lacag dhan 260 milyan oo peso, oo qiyaastii u dhiganta 160,000 doollar, oo Ururka Kubbadda Cagta Argentina (AFA) u wareejiyay madaxweynihiisa Claudio 'Chiqui' Tapia.

item.title: Vancouver Whitecaps oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Real Salt Lake, una gudbay wareegga xiga ee MLS
item.description: Vancouver Whitecaps ayaa Jimcihii 1-0 kaga adkaatay Real Salt Lake kulankii labaad ee wareegga koowaad ee isreebreebka MLS, waxayna taxanaha ku dhammaystireen 2 guul oo aan laga reebin, kaddib gool uu dhaliyay Emmanuel Sabbi.

item.title: Baaskiil wadaha Colombia Harold Tejada oo la hakiyay kaddib cillado laga helay baasaboorkiisa bayoolojiga
item.description: Hay'adda Caalamiga ah ee Kormeerka Daroogada (ITA) ayaa hakisay baaskiil wadaha reer Colombia Harold Tejada, oo kaalinta 10aad ka galay Vuelta 2026, kaddib cillado aan la sharxin oo laga helay qiyamka dhiigga ee baasaboorkiisa bayoolojiga.

item.title: Cooper Flagg oo 34 dhibcood ku keenay Mavericks guul 113-109 ah oo ay ka gaartay Suns
item.description: Dallas Mavericks ayaa Jimcihii garoonka Phoenix kaga adkaatay Suns 113-109, kaddib markii ay ka soo noqdeen 17 dhibcood oo laga hor maray, iyadoo Cooper Flagg uu dhaliyay 34 dhibcood, Mavericksna ay ku heleen kaalinta koowaad ee Galbeedka ee NBA Cup.

item.title: Le Havre iyo Strasbourg oo kulan muhiim ah u wajahaya tababarayaal cusub oo labadooduba guul raadinaya
item.description: Tababarayaasha cusub ee Le Havre iyo Strasbourg, Valérien Ismaël iyo Vitor Matos, ayaa Sabtida isku arkaya garoonka Stade Océane, iyadoo labadooduba ay ku guuldarreysteen kulankoodii ugu horreeyay ee Ligue 1.

item.title: Spurs oo 99-96 kaga adkaaday Lakers, una gudbay siddeed dhammaadka NBA Cup
item.description: San Antonio Spurs ayaa ka soo laabtay 20 dhibcood oo laga hor maray, waxayna 99-96 ku garaaceen Los Angeles Lakers, iyagoo u gudbay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka tartanka NBA Cup, halka Luka Dončić uu kulanka kadib la kulmay taageere riixay.

item.title: Benjamin André oo u dhow 300 kulan oo uu u ciyaaray Lille
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee Lille Benjamin André, oo 36 jir ah, ayaa caawa ka ciyaari kara kulankiisii 300-aad ee kooxda, marka ay Lille booqato Le Mans.

item.title: Taageere ayaa riixay Luka Dončić kaddib markii Lakers looga adkaaday San Antonio
item.description: Xiddigga Los Angeles Lakers Luka Dončić ayaa la riixay xilli uu garoonka ka baxayay kaddib guuldarradii 99-96 ee Spurs, markii uu xarig gacmeedkiisa u tuuray dhinaca haweeney ku fadhiday safka hore.

item.title: FAO iyo WFP: Gaajadu waxay ku sii xoogeysanaysaa 16 goobood, Soomaaliyana waa ka mid
item.description: Laba hay'adood oo cuntada ah oo ka tirsan Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ka digay in gaajadu ay ku sii xumaan doonto 16 goobood oo badankoodu ku yaallaan Afrika lixda bilood ee soo socda, iyagoo Soomaaliya ku daray dalalka ugu walaaca badan.

item.title: Xulka haweenka Mareykanka oo 8-0 ku jabiyay El Salvador, kuna gutay Koobka Adduunka 2027
item.description: Xulka kubadda cagta haweenka ee Mareykanka ayaa 8-0 ku garaacay El Salvador wareegga siddeed dhammaadka tartanka Concacaf W Championship, isagoo kaalin toos ah uga helay Koobka Adduunka Haweenka 2027, halka Ashley Sanchez ay 6 daqiiqo gudahood ku dhalisay 3 gool.

item.title: Texas oo 16-6 ku garaacday Texas A&M, finalka SEC-na kula kulmi doonta Georgia
item.description: Jaamacadda Texas, oo kaalinta 3-aad ku jirta, ayaa 16-6 kaga adkaatay Texas A&M kubbadda cagta Mareykanka, waxayna finalkii ugu dambeeyay ee shirka SEC kula kulmi doontaa Georgia oo kaalinta 1-aad ah.

item.title: Columbus Crew oo 1-0 ku garaacday Inter Miami, Messi iyo kooxdiisana ka saartay MLS
item.description: Columbus Crew ayaa gool uu Santi Rodríguez dhaliyay waqtiga dheeraadka ah ku garaacday Inter Miami 1-0, iyadoo 2-0 ku guuleysatay taxanaha wareegga koowaad ee MLS, taasoo soo afjartay difaaca horyaalnimada Lionel Messi iyo kooxdiisa.

item.title: MSF: Duqeyn Israa'iil ah oo ku dhacday rug caafimaad oo Gaza ah ayaa dishay 2 ka mid ah shaqaalaheeda
item.description: Hay'adda Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudda Lahayn (MSF) ayaa sheegtay in 2 ilaalo oo u shaqeynayay lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil ah oo si toos ah ugu dhacday mid ka mid ah rugaha caafimaadka ee ay ku leedahay magaalada Gaza.

item.title: Baylor oo tababare cusub ka dhigaysa Jeff Traylor oo hore u tababari jiray UTSA
item.description: Jaamacadda Baylor ayaa diyaar u ah inay tababaraha kooxdeeda kubbadda cagta Mareykanka u magacawdo Jeff Traylor, oo 7 xilli ciyaareed hoggaaminayay UTSA, sida ay sheegeen warbixinno ay xaqiijiyeen ilo kala duwan.

item.title: Stephen Curry oo horumar sameeyay, balse ka maqnaan doona ugu yaraan 3 kulan oo kale
item.description: Golden State Warriors ayaa sheegay in Stephen Curry uu horumar wanaagsan ka sameeyay dhaawaca murqaha dhinaca, balse uu seegi doono ugu yaraan 3 kulan oo kale, dib-u-qiimeyn cusubna la sameyn doono Arbacada.

item.title: Jamaica oo 3-0 ku garaacday Costa Rica, kuna guuleysatay kaalin Koobka Adduunka ee Haweenka 2027
item.description: Xulka haweenka Jamaica ayaa Jimcihii 3-0 kaga adkaaday Costa Rica wareegga sideed dhammaadka ee Concacaf W Championship, wuxuuna kaalin toos ah uga helay Koobka Adduunka ee Haweenka 2027.

item.title: Kumanaan qof oo Puerto Rico isugu soo baxay mudaaharaadka "Maalinta Cadhada Qaranka"
item.description: Kumanaan qof ayaa Puerto Rico ka qeybqaatay mudaaharaad loo bixiyay "Maalinta Cadhada Qaranka", kaas oo ay soo abaabuleen ku dhawaad 30 kooxood, xilli biilasha korontada ay kordheen.

item.title: Justin Herbert oo ka maqnaan doona ciyaarta Chargers iyo Patriots, DJ Uiagalelei oo laga yaabo inuu bilaabo
item.description: Quarterback-ka Los Angeles Chargers Justin Herbert ma ciyaari doono ciyaarta toddobaadka 12-aad ee NFL ee New England Patriots, maadaama uu ku jiro nidaamka baaritaanka dhaawaca madaxa, waxaana la filayaa in DJ Uiagalelei uu bilaabo Axadda.

item.title: Ugu yaraan 8 qof oo ku dhintay doon ay saarnaayeen qaxooti oo laga helay meel u dhow jasiiradaha Canary
item.description: Adeegga samatabbixinta badda ee Spain ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, sheegay in ugu yaraan 8 qof oo qaxooti ah laga helay iyagoo dhintay doon ay saarnaayeen qiyaastii 100 qof oo laga badbaadiyay meel u dhow jasiiradaha Canary.

item.title: Pittsburgh Steelers oo 27-5 ku garaacay Denver Broncos, natiijo aan weligeed hore uga dhicin NFL
item.description: Pittsburgh Steelers ayaa Jimcihii Black Friday, 27 November 2026, 27-5 kaga adkaaday Denver Broncos, natiijo markii ugu horreysay ka dhacday 107 sano ee taariikhda NFL, maalmo kadib markii kooxdu sii daysay Aaron Rodgers.

item.title: Thiago Silva oo 42 jir ah ayaa heshiiskiisa Fluminense u kordhiyay ilaa dhammaadka 2027
item.description: Kooxda Fluminense ee Brazil ayaa ku dhawaaqday in daafaca 42 jirka ah Thiago Silva uu heshiis cusub u saxiixay, kaas oo ku hayn doona kooxda ilaa 31 December 2027.

item.title: Tim Stützle oo 2 gool u dhaliyay Ottawa Senators oo 6-2 ku garaacday Tampa Bay
item.description: Xiddiga reer Jarmal Tim Stützle ayaa dhaliyay 2 gool, mid ka mid ah isagoo kooxdiisu ciyaaryahan ka yar tahay, markii Ottawa Senators ay 6-2 kaga adkaatay Tampa Bay Lightning horyaalka NHL.

item.title: Australia oo Nathan Lyon ka saartay kooxda Test-ka ee New Zealand, Corey Rocchiccioli oo la doortay
item.description: Xulashada kooxda cricket-ka Australia ayaa Sabtidii, 28 November 2026, shaacisay koox 13 ciyaaryahan ah oo taxanaha Test-ka kula ciyaari doonta New Zealand, iyadoo laga saaray Nathan Lyon oo muddo 13 sano ahaa spinner-ka koowaad ee dalka.

item.title: Zelenskyy oo qirtay in weerarrada Ukraine ee Libya aan lagala tashan xulafada Yurub
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, qirtay in Kyiv ay weerarradeedii dhowaa ee ka dhanka ahaa maraakiibta Ruushka ee Libya ku fulisay iyadoo aan horay ula tashan xulafadeeda Yurub, kadib dhaleeceyn ka timid Talyaaniga.

item.title: Arteta oo Arsenal u dejiyay bartilmaameed ah 100 dhibcood oo Premier League ah
item.description: Tababaraha Arsenal Mikel Arteta ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo in kooxdiisu noqoto kooxdii labaad ee taariikhda Premier League gaarta 100 dhibcood xilli ciyaareed, ka hor kulanka Axadda ee ay la ciyaarayso Manchester City.

item.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo sheegay inay curyaamiyeen markab ganacsi oo isku dayay inuu jebiyo xannibaadda Iran
item.description: Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in diyaarado milatari ay Khamiistii hub sax ah ku garaaceen markabka ganacsiga ee Pacific Archer ee Gacanka Oman, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inuu isku dayay inuu jebiyo xannibaadda Mareykanka ee dekedaha Iran.

item.title: Racing Santander oo dib uga soo kacday kuna garaacday Levante 3-1, Pablo García oo dhaliyay 2 gool
item.description: Racing Santander ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, garoonka Ciutat de València 3-1 kaga adkaatay Levante, iyadoo Pablo García uu dhaliyay 2 gool, Yassir Zabiri-na mid.
